items.title: Flere biler var involvert i trafikkulykke på E6
items.excerpt: Det ble meldt om at trafikkulykken kunne føre til opp mot en time forsinkelse i trafikken.

items.title: Grotesk kaninfunn i Nydalen – undersøker sammenheng med kattedrap
items.excerpt: Nå granskes funnet i sommer på nytt.

items.title: NRK-profilen enda i badekar etter fantomløp
items.excerpt: NRKs langrennsekspert Pål Golberg blir hylla av Therese Johaug etter løpebragd. Men etter målgang begynte kroppen å skjelve.

items.title: Brann i togbremser – Lillestrøm stasjon stengt
items.excerpt: Et tog måtte søndag kveld evakueres etter at det begynte å brenne i bremsene.

items.title: Early reports suggest record high turnout in Serbia elections
items.excerpt: Polls are closing in Serbia as a student movement attempts to oust longtime populist leader Aleksandar Vučić.

items.title: Birmingham get first win of the season after edging past Charlton
items.excerpt: Wilda Leidhammar scores the only goal as Birmingham secure their first win of the WSL season, beating bottom club Charlton Athletic 1-0 at St Andrews, as the away side's wait for a first point of the season goes on.

items.title: Late own goal gives Liverpool point against London City Lionesses
items.excerpt: A stoppage time own goal from Jana Fernandez sees Liverpool snatch a point against London City Lionesses, as the two sides draw 2-2 in the Women's Super League.

items.title: Vangsgaard scores twice as Villa hang on to beat Everton
items.excerpt: Amalie Vangsgaard scores twice for Aston Villa as the away side survive a late fightback from Everton to win 3-2 at Goodison Park in the Women's Super League.

items.title: Polls close in Serbia as strongman Vučić faces challenge to 12-year rule – Europe live
items.excerpt: The Student List movement is taking on authoritarian leader following nearly two years of protests against government and institutional corruption What is at stake in Serbia’s election? The latest turnout projection by Ipsos/Cesid suggests a turnout of 60.8% by 5pm local time (4pm UK), with three hours still to go until the polling stations close.

items.title: Brazil election 2026: Live second round results
items.excerpt: After a shock defeat in the first round, the incumbent Brazilian president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, is seeking a new term in a runoff with Flávio Bolsonaro, the son of his convicted predecessor Polls close at 17.00 BRT, 20.00 GMT, with first results expected within the hour.
